description: Traffic Lights Data Hamburg is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesbetrieb Straßen, Brücken und Gewässer. LSA process data The data set currently comprises the LSA process data for about half of all nodes connected to the traffic computer network in Hamburg and contains current signal characteristics in real time. In addition, data is transmitted to detectors such as bicycle, pedestrian and vehicle requirements as well as bus messages. Coverage: Landesbetrieb Straßen, Brücken und Gewässer. The publisher named on the listing is Landesbetrieb Straßen, Brücken und Gewässer. Its keywords include Knotentopologie, FROST-Server, Ampeldaten, Lichtsignalanlagen, Ampeln, opendata. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
